critique: The bold collision of CMYK moiré patterns with drifting halftone target discs creates a vibrant, hypnotic Pop Art atmosphere, brilliantly punctuated by the joyful, surreal inclusion of the rotating guinea pig. However, relying on a static external image (`art.png`) inside a basic elliptical clip-path undermines the algorithmic magic; replacing this with a procedurally generated, cyber-organic focal point would significantly elevate the composition's self-contained complexity.
